coverage.basis: Organizer announcement 2025-01-24 explicitly states tickets cover Jan 1 through May 31 2024 and devices absent from tickets had no failure in that interval. Coverage ends at June 1; June-July are unlabeled and excluded.

metadata_policy: Full source timestamps define observation bounds; future feature values and failure outcomes are excluded before normalization. Feature-agent examples use TRAIN only.
